implementation: BuildingLaneJournal EXPORT returns the existing13-field lane format or[] without public lane reads, publication, job mutation or SAVE-budget consumption. SAVE and EXPORT share the serializer/validation and a precomputed encoding-mode flag.

Routes, lane progress, pending indices, ordered entry nodes, request ages and buddy target proposals retain existing bounds and validation. Local clocks encode to original server-time observations without renewed age or grace.

Nested context transform vectors now copy independently, alongside existing route/progress/request/proposal copies. SAVE retains its original1.5s throttle and unchanged public version1/schema13. Legacy modes keep BOOL results.
integrationState: The serializer is already used by production SAVE; EXPORT exposes its pure current-owner output for upcoming producer checkpoint work. No periodic EXPORT caller, transfer capture, network delivery or readiness consumer is enabled by this component.
cost: Existing8lane/512node and per-lane512route bounds retained. SAVE adds typed nonce/context checks and copies three transform vectors instead of a shallow context array. Explicit EXPORT runs the bounded full validation and copying; callers must not poll it per frame. One encoding flag avoids per-row mode-array checks. No new worker, timer, scan or message. Runtime delta unmeasured.
limits: Not a full producer checkpoint: egress, exterior, settings, interruption and retirement domains remain separate.

Current-owner-only EXPORT cannot be called as a final seal after Local loss. A fenced exporter/producer registration and authenticated finite replay still need implementation before changing resume transport.
